name: Vine climb up

v1.prompt: The cat climbs straight up a thick vertical vine, seen from the side: body vertical, head up, front paws reach up and grip in turn, back legs push. The cat stays centred in the frame while climbing in place; the vine is a green vertical rope right in front of the cat's belly. Seamless loop.  Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

v2.prompt: The cat climbs up a thick vertical vine in strict side profile, facing right, left side to the viewer, as in the image; the thin dark collar marking keeps its small shape. Body vertical, head up, front paws reach up and grip in turn, back legs push. It climbs in place, centred; the vine is a green rope in front of its belly. Seamless loop. Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

verdict: usable (v2, default re-cut): climbs in place, marking reads as a back stripe; v1 failed: seen from the back, marking grew into a big diamond pattern, grey shadow patch
suggest: 19 frames (v2 recut_64f_256_bgdefault f14-32, IoU 0.90) at 14 fps; vine baked in
